description.value: Ramada Limited Golden is a motel-style property in Golden, BC, operating under the Wyndham Hotels umbrella in the heart of the Kootenays. Golden sits at the confluence of the Kicking Horse and Columbia Rivers and serves as a gateway to Yoho National Park and the Trans-Canada cycling corridor. As a nationally recognized mid-range brand with a fixed address in a small mountain town, it is a predictable overnight option for long-distance touring cyclists passing through.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content fetched from the Wyndham Hotels corporate page for this property is almost entirely navigation boilerplate and booking-widget UI, with no property-specific amenity details for Ramada Limited Golden. Accordingly, nearly all amenity fields must be null. OSM confirms internet_access=wlan but per rules this tag alone is insufficient to assert Wi-Fi without website corroboration. The property is a real, branded Ramada/Wyndham motel in Golden, BC with no closure signals.
concerns: Website content returned is almost entirely Wyndham corporate navigation boilerplate with no property-specific amenity text; no cyclist-relevant amenities could be confirmed or denied from the website.

Fetched content includes subpages for unrelated Wyndham brands (WaterWalk, Hawthorn Extended Stay), suggesting the scraper may have captured multiple pages from the Wyndham domain rather than only the Golden property page.
